newsList.title: Update
newsList.body:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while and we thank you for your patience. As of now, there are 266 unverified runs and it is currently not possible for the team to get through them. As for me, I am busy for the next two weeks due to exams. But as soon as they finish, I will go through each and every ru

categories.name: Tutorial
categories.rules:
Complete the tutorial as fast as possible.
Leave "Brawler" empty.

Timer :

- Starts: First frame of movement
- Stops: When Shelly points her gun at the air

categories.name: 60 Trophies%
categories.rules:
Claim the Daily Quests at 60 trophies (replaced Colt) on the trophy road as fast as possible.

- Must start with 0 total trophies and all trophy road rewards unclaimed

Timer :

- Starts: When you hit “Play” to start your first match
- Stops: When you tap on the Daily Quests

categories.name: 250 Trophies%
categories.rules:

- Must start with 0 total trophies and all trophy road rewards unclaimed

Timer :

- Stops: When you tap on the Season Quests reward

categories.name: 500 Trophies%
categories.rules:

- Stops: When you tap on the 500 credit reward

categories.name: Showdown
categories.rules:
- You must play solo. 
- The goal is to win as quickly as possible.
- Friendly games are not allowed.

Timer : 
- Starts: When your brawler is able to move.
- Stops: When the last brawler dies.

Aditional rule :
- The video must be upload on youtube to have a frame perfect time

categories.name: Duo Showdown
categories.rules:

- The goal is to win as quickly as possible.
- Friendly games are not allowed.

Timer : 
- Starts: When your brawler is able to move.
- Stops: When the last brawler dies.

Additional rule :
- The video must be upload on youtube to have a frame perfect time

categories.name: Survival
categories.rules:
Try to survive as long as possible in "Showdown".

- You must play solo.
- There's no need to win the game.
- Friendly games are not allowed.

Timer : 
- Starts: When your brawler is able to move.
- Stops: When the last brawler dies.

Additional rule :
- The video must be upload on youtube to have a frame perfect time
